purpose: Generate a reproducible candidate pool by minimizing cumulative selfish behavior separately on three networks under one common optimization specification.

objective.name: cumulative_selfish_fraction
objective.scope: Optimize each network separately; do not combine networks into one objective.

design_variables.fixed_condition_policy: Keep every non-optimized intervention, agent, information, timing, and source-selection setting unchanged from the current prior-study-based configuration.

fairness_rules: Use the same objective, bounds, iterations, evaluations, optimizer replicate count, simulator seed, and retained raw level for every network and method.
Count the BO-GP startup trials inside the 50-evaluation budget.
Use distinct optimizer seeds across methods while preserving the same six replicate identifiers.
Record method-specific initialization rather than changing an algorithm to imitate another method.
Do not replace failed trials with a favorable value or an ordinary worst-case objective value.
Require all 50 trials in every run to complete before the Stage 6 analysis is accepted.

method_comparison.reason: Stage 6 is candidate generation on one exploration simulator-seed block, not an independent final-performance test.

candidate_pool.source: The best complete trial from every network-method-optimizer-replicate run.
candidate_pool.selection_policy: Preserve all run-level best candidates and provenance. Candidate clustering and shortlisting are deferred to Stage 7.

target_attainment.policy: Do not invent a post-hoc objective threshold. Report the evaluation where each run first found its own final incumbent; define cross-candidate acceptance using independent validation in Stage 7.

interpretation_limits: Search values from simulator seed 30001 are exploratory and are not final suppression-effect estimates.
A condition is not called suppressive until it is compared with no intervention on independent paired simulator-seed blocks.
The exact prior_high CSV is a prior-study package benchmark and is not assumed to be reachable by changing only certainty and effectiveness in the generated intervention family.
Stage 6 selects a candidate pool; Stage 7 performs independent validation and candidate selection.
